name: How long does a typical exterior painting project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical exterior painting project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior painting project varies significantly based on the size and complexity of the house, the extent of surface preparation required, weather conditions, and the size of the painting crew. A small to medium-sized home might take 3-7 days, while larger or more intricate homes with extensive prep work could take 1-3 weeks or more. This timeframe includes preparation, priming, painting multiple coats, and drying time between coats.
acceptedAnswer.description: An exterior painting project typically takes 3 days to 3 weeks, depending on house size, prep work, and weather conditions.
